title: OSC named-instrument lifecycle and public-recovery ledger · acquisition 01

selection_contract.universe: The five named OSC instruments frozen by SSC-F10-OSC-01.

sources.title: Office of Strategic Capital Announces First Loan Through DoD Agreement With MP Materials
supports: OSC described the MP Materials instrument as its first executed direct loan.
The stated principal amount was 150 million dollars.
does_not_support: complete OSC applicant or selected cohort

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / MP Materials Corp.
sources.title: MP Materials 2025 Form 10-K
supports: MP Materials issued a 150 million dollar unsecured promissory note in August 2025.
The note matures on August 1, 2037 and bears interest at 5.38 percent per annum.
Interest is payable quarterly in cash beginning October 15, 2025.
The 150 million dollar Samarium Project Loan remained outstanding at December 31, 2025.
does_not_support: observed payment of every scheduled interest installment

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / MP Materials Corp.
sources.title: MP Materials quarter ended March 31, 2026
supports: The Samarium Project Loan remained an outstanding 150 million dollar obligation at March 31, 2026.
The disclosed tenor, maturity and 5.38 percent interest terms remained in force.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / MP Materials Corp.
sources.title: MP Materials Transaction Agreement and exhibits
supports: The wider DoD transaction included preferred stock, a company warrant, a loan agreement, price protection and an offtake agreement.
The loan must remain analytically separate from the companion equity, warrant, price-support and offtake instruments.
does_not_support: that every companion right is loan-specific

sources.title: OSC Joint Conditional Loan Commitment with Vulcan Elements and ReElement Technologies
supports: OSC announced separate conditional commitments of 620 million dollars to Vulcan and 80 million dollars to ReElement.
Financial, legal, technical and other due-diligence conditions remained before financial close.
The release states that no OSC funds are disbursed until the conditions for disbursement are met.
The Department expected warrants from Vulcan and ReElement, while Commerce announced separate proposed incentives and equity.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / American Resources Corporation
sources.title: American Resources Form 8-K concerning ReElement
supports: The filing describes the 80 million dollar ReElement and 620 million dollar Vulcan commitments as OSC commitments matched by private capital.
It states that the Department would receive warrants in ReElement.

sources.title: OSC Conditional Loan Commitment With Phoenix Tailings
supports: OSC announced a 500 million dollar conditional commitment.
Financial, legal, technical and other due-diligence conditions remained before financial close.

sources.title: OSC Conditional Loan Commitment With Energy Fuels
supports: OSC announced a 725 million dollar conditional commitment.
Financial, legal, technical and other due-diligence conditions remained before financial close.
The release states that FY2026 OSC debt commitments exceeded 5 billion dollars, so the five named instruments are not a complete current denominator.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Energy Fuels Inc.
sources.title: Energy Fuels Form 8-K concerning the OSC commitment
supports: Energy Fuels described the proposed OSC loan as a 725 million dollar, 20-year conditional financing commitment.
The commitment remained subject to further due diligence, final agreements, customary closing conditions and approvals.
The filing expressly warned that the proposed OSC financing might not be completed or funded.

open_denominators: final agreements, closing conditions and financial-close records for Vulcan, ReElement, Phoenix Tailings and Energy Fuels
actual disbursement, draw and use-of-proceeds records for every instrument
exact warrant, equity, security, covenant, milestone, pricing and seniority terms separated by public instrument
project milestone, production, schedule, cost, failure, amendment and waiver records
interest and principal payment, default, cure and acceleration records
observed public recovery, retained value and unresolved public exposure
reconciliation of the five named instruments to the inaugural NOFA and the larger FY2026 OSC commitment denominator
unsuccessful applicant, ordinary financing and transparent industrial-policy controls
